# Local graph layout dependency

`elk.bundled.js` is the unchanged elkjs **0.11.1** npm distribution, under
EPL-2.0. `provenance.json` records the tarball integrity and exact file SHA-256.
Source and build instructions: <https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.11.1>.
The upstream tag retains the security release; upgrading is an explicit engine,
configuration, negative-control and native/live reading review.

Rust embeds these bytes with `include_str!` and executes only this trusted code in
rquickjs 0.11.0. Node/npm are development comparison tools, not installed runtime
requirements. No browser asset, remote loader or authored script runs the engine.
The Rust adapter sends measured rectangles and bounded identities; upstream output
cannot supply labels, claims, source authority or reversed semantic directions.

The Viewer retains conservative text metrics, complete labels and a separate
sequence renderer. ELK is not a typography service or proof of comprehension.
See the maintained Projection, Reader and Versioning owners for current policy.
